programme.desc: A sous chef aboard a cruise ship leaves her shift unexpectedly and is never seen again; the pressure of the kitchen may have pushed her take her own life, or maybe there was foul play occur; the clues could help solve the mystery.

programme.title: Bill
programme.desc: A husband and wife take a cruise to celebrate their good luck in business. They take the time to really enjoy themselves on the ship and are having the time of their lives. But their luck takes a turn at the apex of their journey, with many wondering what happened aboard the ship.

programme.title: George
programme.desc: Newlyweds board a cruise ship, but things take a turn for the worse when one disappears in the middle of the night. A blood stained canopy is all the only tell tale sign of a young man's fate, leaving many more questions than answers to what happened.

programme.title: Sally
programme.desc: A savvy poker player, Sally Harper, cleans up at the tables in the ship's luxurious casino once at sea, and is having the time of her life. But after she witnesses Paul Shepherd going overboard, many begin to wonder if it was accidental or on purpose. And who could be next?

programme.title: Gordon
programme.desc: Gordon and his wife Eileen take a cruise celebrating their hard work and winning millions in the lottery. But their luck changes drastically and the friends who are on board, as their guests, now aid in the search for the farmer who is now missing at sea.

programme.title: Hunted in Hollywood
programme.desc: Jane King is dying to be an actress. In the process of going to auditions, getting head-shots and attending acting classes she meets a man who claims to have connections with a major studio. But the claim is a lie and weeks later police find her body. The circumstances of her murder are eerily similar to other recent homicides in LA - and it takes two years and many more victims to bring the infamous Hillside Stranglers to justice.

Her career is taking off and she meets the perfect guy when she falls for a Cirque du Soleil performer - but after landing a solo in the acclaimed burlesque show "Fantasy" her body is found cut up and encased in cement.

programme.title: Hollywood Horror
programme.desc: Linda Sobek is a swimsuit model and former LA Raiders cheerleader who goes missing after a desert photo shoot and just before a wardrobe fitting for comedic series Married with Children. Police must uncover a twisted trail of clues that lead to a killer who claimed her death was accidental - though physical evidence suggests something far more sinister.

programme.title: Fallen Starlet
programme.desc: Rebecca Schaeffer is an aspiring actress who bursts onto the scene with a starring role in the hit sitcom My Sister Sam. However, fame comes with a price and just hours before her audition for Godfather III, she is found shot on her LA doorstep. Who could have wanted this rising star dead? The killer left few clues behind and investigators must unlock the secrets of a puzzling crime scene to catch him.

programme.title: Nashville Nightmare
programme.desc: Melissa Haferman is an aspiring country singer on the verge of a recording contract. She goes missing after traveling to Nashville to record a demo and is found strangled to death with her own rodeo belt. Evidence leads to a man who eliminated the rising star to boost his own twisted thirst for fame.

programme.title: Fatal Audition
programme.desc: Karin Schlegel beats hundreds to win the starring role in a feature film with an up-and-coming New York City director. Before the movie begins shooting, she gets another big gig - an opportunity to model for a national print ad. She goes to the shoot - and vanishes. When her body turns up nude on top of an apartment building, the police investigation reveals a psychologically twisted killer and a nightmare that shakes the Big Apple to its core.

programme.title: Knock Knock You're Dead
programme.desc: Summer, 2001 and Southern Louisiana is held in the terrifying grip of a serial killer whose initial ‘hot zone’ is the Louisiana State University area of Baton Rouge. The number of victims is growing and all are attractive, successful young women -- women whose mainstream, “low risk” lifestyle should never put them on the radar of a killer. But this is the hardest kind of serial killer to catch -- impulsive, always changing his M.O. An unprecedented coalition of state and federal police agencies, including the FBI, will join forces to solve this disturbing, yet fascinating case. State of the art forensic science, particularly case-making DNA analysis, will turn the tables on this killer and finally put a face to the monster that haunts Southern Louisiana.

programme.title: Forsaken
programme.desc: On the outskirts of Hamilton, Ontario, a jogger makes a gruesome discovery – the partially mummified remains of a human body. Using state of the art forensics, police are able to identify the body as that of a suburban wife and mother of two. She has been brutally bludgeoned to death, but no missing person’s report has ever been filed. As police investigate, they discover evidence of domestic strife, including a love triangle and charges of assault. Determined to find the killer, police dig further into the victim’s life, doggedly tracking down a former lover to New York City, where they uncover another crime. But it is a forensic entomologist and her knowledge of the minute lives of insects that leads investigators back to Ontario and the arrest of the woman’s husband for murder.

programme.title: Pyro
programme.desc: A series of over sixty spectacular fires rips through California’s San Joaquin valley, killing four people and devastating the landscape. An extensive investigation by the ATF, police and forensic scientists reveals a common pattern among all the blazes, and to their horror, authorities soon realize that a serial arsonist is on the loose. As they painstakingly study the evidence from each crime scene, a single fingerprint leads them to one suspect. He is John Leonard Orr, a respected arson investigator for the Glendale Fire Department in Southern California and one of the worst serial arsonists of the 20th century.

programme.title: The Fifth Commandment
programme.desc: A double homicide in Hudson, Wisconsin leaves a small town reeling and two young detectives with little to go on. The victims are upright citizens, shot execution style, with no apparent motive. In Agatha Christie-like fashion, a tantalizing array of suspects emerge but after two years, there are still no arrests. Richard Walter, the famed criminal profiler, becomes intrigued by the cold case and narrows the suspect list down until only one man is left standing. And no one can believe who that person is. A combination of expert crime scene analysis, computer forensics and the perpetrator’s own pathological urge to talk… the bereaved families finally see justice served.

programme.title: Leaving Las Vegas
programme.desc: Glamorous Las Vegas, Nevada is famous for wealth, lady luck and second chances. But when homicide detectives discover the charred remains of a prominent business man, Sin City reveals a darker side. With a long list of suspects and millions of dollars on the line, investigators are suddenly thrust into a dangerous world of high stakes deception fueled by passion, greed and revenge. A murder mystery where nothing is as it seems and anyone is capable of anything, only forensic science can expose the truth and catch the killer.

programme.title: The Green Berets: Vietnam - The Battle of Lang Vei
programme.desc: On January 31, 1968, North Vietnam violates a truce during "Tet", the Vietnamese New Year. programme.title: GSG-9: Jihad in the Fatherland

programme.title: The Fifth Commandment
programme.desc: A double homicide in Hudson, Wisconsin leaves a small town reeling and two young detectives with little to go on. Claiming responsibility for the reign of terror, is a deadly, almost invisible sect called the Phineas Priests who seem to strike at will. The phantom cell, driven by a perverted code of hate is considered be the most radical and dangerous in the entire white supremacist movement. Although the gunmen are masked and leave few clues, an FBI forensic photoanalysis team, working with high quality bank surveillance footage, slowly starts to get a clearer picture of the assailants. The question is, can they find them before they strike again?

programme.title: Fall of a Serial Killer
programme.desc: In Illinois, a 16-year-old boy goes to speak with a contractor about a summer job. He tells his mother it'll only take a minute, but no one ever sees him again. programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Eight: Perspective and Peace: Embracing Gratitude
programme.desc: In this episode of 'Pardon My Peace,' Danielle and Shay dive into a thought-provoking discussion about the significance of perspective in our lives. They explore the difference between needs and wants, sharing personal stories and reflecting on how our mindset shapes our appreciation for what we have. The conversation touches on topics like Southern California's unpredictable weather, the desire for new possessions, and the impact of modern society on our perceptions of adequacy. Danielle challenges herself and the listeners to differentiate between 'needs' and 'wants,' emphasizing gratitude and contentment. The episode encourages listeners to reflect on their own lives, offering humorous anecdotes and real-life examples to drive home the message of intentional living and genuine self-reflection.

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Eleven: The Weight of a Mother's Faith Our Sickle Cell Testimony Part One
programme.desc: In this heartfelt episode of Pardon My Peace, Danielle shares the moving story of her son, Thomas Parker III, who was born with sickle cell disease. She recounts Parker's birth experience, early health challenges, and the emotional journey from initial diagnosis to ongoing care. With faith, determination, and a strong support system, Danielle navigates the complexities of raising a child with chronic illness, while ensuring he leads a fulfilling life. This episode provides a deep look into the resilience and love that drive a mother's commitment to her child’s well-being.

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Five: Empowerment in Solitude: Date Yourself!
programme.desc: In this episode of 'Pardon My Peace,' Danielle and Shay discuss the concept of 'dating yourself.' They explore personal experiences and the benefits of taking time for self-care and doing things solo. The conversation touches on growing confidence, the importance of self-love, and how societal expectations often make such practices challenging. Whether you're single, in a relationship, or a busy mom, they share insights on how to make time for yourself and why it's essential for overall well-being. Tune in for an inspiring discussion on normalizing self-dates, building confidence, and celebrating individuality.

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Four: DEA Busts, Fiery Conversations, and Dating Dilemmas
programme.desc: In this episode of 'Pardon My Piece,' hosts Danielle and Shay dive into a lively discussion filled with personal stories and reflections. Filmed during an evening session, they explore topics such as the hosts' preference for nighttime energy, the nap debate, memorable college experiences, and the cultural differences in substance use. They also touch on the impact of natural disasters like California fires, the importance of healthy eating, and Shay's personal revelation about her dating life and the importance of shooting your shot. It's a candid conversation that offers a mix of humor, nostalgia, and genuine advice.

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Nine: Fun Facts and True Friendship: How Well Do You Know Me?
programme.desc: Join Danielle and Shay in an engaging and hilarious episode of 'Pardon My Peace' as they dive into a series of personal questions in the game 'How Well Do You Know Me?'. programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode One: The Danielle Interview

We also discuss overcoming fears and insecurities, such as body dysmorphia, and the ways personal growth shapes our lives. Danielle shares how her son's battle with sickle cell disease strengthened her faith and relationship with God. Join us for honest conversations and a dose of authenticity.

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Seven: Unpacking the Burden: Should Women Fix Men?

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Six: Exploring Femininity: Softness, Strength, and Everything In Between

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Ten: The Friendship Spectrum: From Daily Chats to Timeless Bonds
programme.desc: In this heartfelt episode, Danielle and Shay reflect on personal experiences, discussing the differences between high maintenance and low maintenance friendships. programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Three: Marriage: Commitment, Paper, or Both?
programme.desc: In this heartfelt episode of 'Pardon My Peace,' Danielle interviews her close friend Shay. The episode also explores their rekindled friendship after years of separation, showcasing the power of honesty, growth, and forgiveness. Shay shares her passions, life lessons, and dreams, making this an inspirational story not just about friendship but also about self-discovery and resilience. Don't miss this authentic conversation filled with humor, love, and real talk. programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Twelve: The Weight of a Mother's Faith Our Sickle Cell Testimony Part Two
programme.desc: In this heartfelt episode, we explore the inspiring story of Parker, a young boy who battled sickle cell disease and braved the challenges of a bone marrow transplant during the COVID-19 pandemic. Discover how Parker's resilience, family support, and their steadfast faith led to his miraculous recovery. This episode delves into the medical, emotional, and spiritual aspects of their experience, highlighting the critical role of testimonies and the importance of becoming an advocate for others facing similar challenges.

programme.title: Below Watson's
programme.desc: Beneath the charm of Watson’s Soda Fountain and Café on East Chapman Avenue in Orange, California, lies a mystery sealed in brick and shadow. Once a bustling drug store and diner during the Prohibition era, the café is said to sit above a hidden network of tunnels that have long been blocked from public view. Were these tunnels a lifeline, a smuggling route—or something far more dangerous? This documentary highlights the community that whispers about the layers of history, chasing the echoes of footsteps that may never have wanted to be found.

programme.title: Chick Bait
programme.desc: In this lighthearted comedy, a lonely, overweight man just wants to enjoy a quiet afternoon and his baskin robbins Ice cream. But his simple pleasure takes a wild turn when a mischievous dachshund waddles up, steals his sweet trea. the man tries to shoo the dog away, but fate has other plans. A charming young woman notices the adorable thief and mistakes the man for its doting owner. Suddenly thrust into an unexpected role, he finds himself sharing laughs and lunch with her, daydreaming that maybe, just maybe, this accident could lead to love. But just as the sparks begin to flicker, disaster strikes. The real owner appears, frantic and furious at finding the “lost” dog in the man’s company. A story of ice cream, mistaken identity, and a very determined little dog.

programme.title: Father Figure
programme.desc: Richard kidnaps his two children, consumed by resentment toward his ex-wife, Diana, and convinced that only he can provide them a safe home. But as his desperation grows, Richard's obsessive need for control begins to expose the monstrous reflection of his own flaws. Meanwhile, their fractured family becomes the target of the Father Figure-a sinister entity that preys on children from broken, unstable homes. When the demon abducts the children, Richard is forced to face the consequences of his destructive choices and the darker truths about himself. Now, he must confront the ultimate evil to save his children, before his mistakes doom him forever.

programme.desc: In this episode of Mic’d Up: The Podcast, Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith tackle some of the hottest topics in pop culture and beyond. First up: The mystery behind stolen Nikes—did Nike orchestrate the theft themselves? Then, they dive into the collaboration between the Lakers and One Piece, along with opening exclusive One Piece trading cards! The conversation heats up as they discuss the SAG Awards and the controversial nightlife rules and discrimination issues in big cities like LA. Tune in for an insightful, no-holds-barred discussion on current events and pop culture!

But that’s not all—things get even more interesting when they break open a Pokémon Prismatic ETB box and explore the world of collectibles. The episode wraps up with a deep dive into the Mavericks’ recent struggles, including Kyrie Irving’s unexpected injury and what this means for the team’s future.

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 005: Running the LA Marathon for Charity, Crypto Talk, NFL Trades & Japanese One Piece Cards
programme.desc: In this episode of Mic'd Up: The Podcast, Michelangelo Falcon shares his personal journey as he prepares to run the LA Marathon this Sunday for charity. He talks about the motivation and drive required to commit to such a challenge and explains how anyone can push themselves to achieve big goals, no matter the obstacles. The conversation then shifts to the world of cryptocurrency, as Michelangelo and Daniel Smith break down the latest trends and discuss NFL trades. To cap off the episode, they open some rare Japanese One Piece trading cards.

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 006: Adan Castillo on Training the Paul Brothers, Motivation & Pulling a Rare Pokémon Card
programme.desc: This week on Mic’d Up: The Podcast, we welcome a special guest—celebrity boxing coach Adan Castillo, the man behind Logan Paul’s training for The Mayweather Fight and Jake Paul’s transition into pro boxing. Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith dive deep into the world of elite training, discussing the mindset, motivation, and sacrifices it takes to succeed at the highest level. Beyond the ring, the conversation expands to the importance of inner circles, overcoming struggles, and the drive to chase your goals—whether you’re a celebrity or an everyday person striving for greatness. To top it off, the guys open Pokémon cards and pull the rarest card yet!

programme.desc: Piro forgot about Liza's birthday and tried to find a gift quickly. Liza's BFF bought the same dress and dressed it for a party. It's a disaster!

programme.title: TeenVee
programme.desc: What would your life be like if you were a police officer? Watch how Piro graduated from the police academy and Liza became a secret agent!

programme.title: Episode 1: GREETINGS FROM DAZZLE LAND
programme.desc: In the first episode, Bommi's dream comes true when her book Libro comes to life and magically transports her into Dazzle Land where she meets her life-long, pop-up book friends.

programme.title: Episode 2: SNOOGLE BERRY DELIGHT
programme.desc: Picking, sorting, juicing and baking Dazzle Land's colorful Snoogleberries can be a lot of fun, if you follow the directions. It takes teamwork and an imaginative Dazzle to sort things out again.

programme.title: Episode 3: CHEARS FOR FEAR
programme.desc: In a Dazzle Land amusement park, Bommi and her friends confront different things that they fear, such as heights and darkness. All except Rumba, why?

programme.title: Episode 4: A TACO TALE
programme.desc: On Dazzle Land Beach Day, Taco borrows Remba's beautiful Snazzle Bedazzle Shell necklace. When he accidentally loses it, he doesn't immediately tell the truth, leading to difficult situations..

programme.title: Episode 5: THE EXERT-A-TRON
programme.desc: Maya invents the Exert-A-Tron, an exercising machine that promises all the benefits of exercise without actually expending any effort. The Exert-A-Tron misses a fundamental point: exercise is fun!

programme.title: Episode 6: DAZZLE LAND ART DAY
programme.desc: DazzleLand Art Day is the perfect chance for Bommi and her friends to discover that everyone is an artist and we can all create beautiful things.

programme.title: Episode 7: BORIS' BIRTHDAY
programme.desc: After a delicious Razzle Dazzle Birthday Frazzle, it's time for Boris's birthday gifts. But it turns out that his Dazzle Land gifts are better suited for the givers than Boris

programme.title: Episode 8: RAINBOW-ZZLES AND DAZZLE
programme.desc: When Yip doesn't share his skateboard with Taco, and Remba doesn't share her secret Rainbow-zzle recipe with Maya, the friendships in Dazzle Land begin to frazzle.

programme.title: Episode 9: TRY TRY AGAIN
programme.desc: Remba believes that she can learn to the play borzzlehorn just by listening to it. Yip believes that he can learn to jump rope just by watching Taco.

programme.title: Episode 10: A LITTLE HELP FROM MY FRIENDS
programme.desc: A magical dazzle kite draws pictures in the sky, alerting Bommi and friends to others in need. In a fun sequence of adventures, everyone realizes how friendships are made stronger

programme.title: Episode 11: A TAILING TALE
programme.desc: Razzle Dazzle Day celebrates the uniqueness of Dazzle Land with a Surprise Dazzle. But it only happens if all the friends are together at sunset ...

programme.title: Episode 12: THE BIG CLEAN
programme.desc: Unusual Clean-up Weather is heading the way of Bommi and Friends! After the falling soap bubbles, the rain and the drying wind machines, it's time to put everything away

programme.title: Episode 13: THE GREAT RACE
programme.desc: It's the great Fazzmobile Relay Race and Maya has promised Yip that he can drive one of the Fazzmobiles. However, she reconsiders and decides to drive it herself, breaking her promise to Yip.

programme.desc: Kellie Bowman, daughter of the late Dr. Sebi, owner of Sebi’s Daughters LLC, and celebrity nurse, is a passionate advocate for holistic health practices that can truly transform lives. With a profound understanding of the mind-body connection passed down from her father, Kellie offers a unique blend of insights that can empower informed choices for holistic well-being. She's also working on a national holiday to honor her late father's pioneer work in the health and wellness sector and speaks on the Dr. Sebi documentary Nick Cannon is working on.

programme.title: Jay Jordan of Reform Alliance Explains Importance of Probation Reform
programme.desc: Jay Jordan, Reform Alliance’s new VP of Community Engagement, is shedding light on the nonprofit’s new C-Suite additions and the critical role they’ll play in driving its mission forward. He breaks down why Reform’s focus on probation and parole reform is so essential to criminal justice reform—and how having major celebrity support helps bring both attention and bipartisan momentum to the cause.

programme.title: Yvette Nicole Brown & Kym Whitley Sound Off On Trump & Defend Mayor Bass
programme.desc: Actresses Yvette Nicole Brown and Kym Whitley aren't biting their tongues when it comes to defending Los Angeles Mayor Karen Bass from criticism over her response to the SoCal wildfires, blasting the Black celebs who performed at Trump's inauguration, and giving their two senses on what the next four years hold. The "Act Your Age" stars sit down with BLACK ENTERPRISE to share their spirited take on the current state of the country.

programme.title: Gabrielle Union Shares Kaavia's Inspiration In New PROUDLY Clothing Launch
programme.desc: Actress and entrepreneur Gabrielle Union is leading the expansion of her PROUDLY baby care line into babywear. In a conversation with Jeroslyn JoVonn on The Culture Shift, Union shares how her daughter Kaavia inspired the designs and opens up about how she and husband Dwyane Wade collaborate on family and business decisions.

programme.title: "The American Society of Magical Negroes" Director Explains Use of Satire
programme.desc: "The American Society of Magical Negroes" director and cast sits down with BLACK ENTERPRISE "The Culture Shift" to share how the satirical comedy tackles the “magical negro” trope popularized in American cinema and television throughout the 20th Century. Director Kobi Libii, lead actor Justice Smith, and supporting actress Nicole Byer explain the film's plot and it aims to inspire Black viewers to see the value in themselves.

programme.title: Lil Jon Manifests Abundance On New Guided Meditation Album
programme.desc: After 20 years of helping us turn up, Grammy award-winning rapper/producer Lil Jon is assisting us with turning down and tuning in to ourselves with his second guided meditation album "Manifest Abundance." The album coincides with his partnership with the wellness supplement brand Natural Vitality during Mental Health Awareness Month. Lil Jon sits down with Black Enterprise to share how he found the balance between partying for work and practicing mindfulness during his downtime. He also shares the perfect mantra to use throughout the day.

programme.title: Self-Reliance - How It Can Help You Get Farther Ahead
programme.desc: In this episode of "The Rundown with Ramon," media consultant Maha Abouelenein discusses her new book, "Seven Rules of Self-Reliance." In this interview with Ramon Ray, publisher of ZoneofGenius.com, Abouelenein shares insights from her career working with tech giants and high-profile individuals, offering practical advice for personal and professional growth. She emphasizes the importance of creating value, managing one's reputation, and adopting a long-term mindset. Abouelenein also shares personal experiences that shaped her approach to life and work, providing listeners with actionable strategies for success in today's fast-paced world.

programme.title: Black Owned Stock Exchange is Expanding Public Market Access
programme.desc: Joe Cecala, co-founder of The Dream Exchange, is on a mission to create America's first minority-owned stock exchange. In an interview with small business expert Ramon Ray, Cecala outlined his vision for revolutionizing capital formation for small and underserved businesses. The Dream Exchange aims to fill a crucial gap in the market by providing public market access to companies seeking $5-100 million in funding, a range often overlooked by traditional financial institutions. The exchange's focus on underserved markets, including minority-owned businesses and companies in overlooked regions, sets it apart from existing exchanges. Cecala emphasized the broader implications of this venture, seeing it as a catalyst for innovation, job creation, and economic growth across diverse communities. While still navigating the complex regulatory process, The Dream Exchange is poised to potentially reshape the landscape of public markets, offering new opportunities for both entrepreneurs and investors. Cecala's parting message encapsulates the exchange's ethos: "Don't quit on your dreams."

programme.title: Can Everyone Be a Millionaire? With This Mindset, Yes!

In an interview with Toyin Crandell, founder of Toyin Crandell Coaching, Ramon Ray unpacks her journey from financial apathy to business success, providing inspiration and insights for anyone looking to redefine their relationship with money and success. Crandell’s story is a testament to the power of a money mindset shift — one that led her from feeling indifference toward money to setting an ambitious financial goal and achieving it in just three years.

programme.title: Black Owned Stock Exchange is Expanding Public Market Access
programme.desc: Joe Cecala, co-founder of The Dream Exchange, is on a mission to create America's first minority-owned stock exchange. In an interview with small business expert Ramon Ray, Cecala outlined his vision for revolutionizing capital formation for small and underserved businesses. The Dream Exchange aims to fill a crucial gap in the market by providing public market access to companies seeking $5-100 million in funding, a range often overlooked by traditional financial institutions. The exchange's focus on underserved markets, including minority-owned businesses and companies in overlooked regions, sets it apart from existing exchanges. Cecala emphasized the broader implications of this venture, seeing it as a catalyst for innovation, job creation, and economic growth across diverse communities. While still navigating the complex regulatory process, The Dream Exchange is poised to potentially reshape the landscape of public markets, offering new opportunities for both entrepreneurs and investors. Cecala's parting message encapsulates the exchange's ethos: "Don't quit on your dreams."

programme.title: Don't Try to Hide Personal from Business on Social Media
programme.desc: Many business owners ask if they can post personal and business on social media. YES, it's good to share your personal life, to some degree on your business oriented social media. programme.title: How To Build Generational Wealth Starting with Your Children
programme.desc: Hey everyone! Today we're diving into an eye-opening conversation with Holly Reid, CEO of The Master Playbook. Holly's on a mission to help families and business owners build lasting wealth and leave a powerful legacy. In this interview with Ramon Ray, publisher of ZoneofGenius.com, key takeaways from our chat included: 1. Legacy building isn't just for the ultra-rich. It's about creating value that lasts beyond your lifetime. 2. Forget complex financial jargon - Holly focuses on mindset shifts to kickstart your wealth journey. 3. Resistance from family members? Holly offers tips to address concerns and highlight the positive impact of increased wealth. 4. We discuss the importance of preparing your business for unexpected events. Holly shared a personal story that really drives this point home. 5. Action steps you can take today: Adopt a "legacy builder mentality," invest in yourself and your community, and start documenting your business assets properly. Holly's company, The Master Playbook, is all about empowering the next generation to master money. Whether you're a parent or a business owner, her insights can help you create a lasting financial impact. Remember, as Holly says, "Legacy isn't built on intention alone. You have to take intentional action." So let's get out there and start building our financial legacies!

programme.title: Success is in Sight, Now What?
programme.desc: When bars and pubs across the world closed during the pandemic, so did their game nights. For Mark Walsh, it was a heart-stopping moment as British pub quizzes were his business. He immediately set to work reimagining this unique style of trivia entertainment by creating his Kwizzbit app. The growth has been so fast that his team has been working to redevelop the platform to be able to host up to 100,000 players at a time. But Marks been struggling to meet the demands.

programme.title: DON'T Compare Yourself To Others and Why Comparison Is Killing Your Joy
programme.desc: In the age of social media, comparison is an all too common issue. Whether we realize it or not, we're constantly comparing ourselves to others; the problem is that it's killing our joy. That's right. Much of the time, all it's doing is making us less satisfied with ourselves. We only see the best parts of people around us and compare them to the worst parts of our lives. Learn why we must stop this cycle, and exactly how you can do it.

programme.title: How To Find A Job You Love and The Importance Of Having A Vision In Life
programme.desc: Having a vision matters because it will help you find a job you love. The thing is, too many people end up working jobs that make them feel unfulfilled. By taking time to figure out what you really want, you can set yourself on the path to finding your dream job. There are two broad categories of jobs out there: survival jobs and dream jobs. Survival jobs are those jobs that you take for a variety of reasons, but they arent really what you aspire to. Maybe you needed money to pay off a loan, or maybe a job didnt turn out the way you thought it would but you didnt feel like changing. Dream jobs, on the other hand, are jobs that make you feel alive. So why arent more of us working our dream jobs? Well, it can be difficult to find a job you love if you dont even know what that dream job would look like. This is why having a vision is so critical. A vision provides clarity and direction for your life.

Damon later opened DD172, an art gallery and creative collective in New York City, in addition to founding Creative Control -- a digital media platform that explored the intersection of music, art and culture. His portfolio of ventures also includes a spirits company, another clothing company and Dame Dash Studios. The veteran Silicon Valley entrepreneur, advisor, investor, speaker, and best-selling author has founded or co-founded half-a-dozen successful startups and mentored scores of entrepreneurs from first-time business owners to established CEOs. Be a fly on the boardroom wall as Marc's podcast opens up the opportunity for entrepreneurs everywhere to gain the benefit of his years of experience as he helps each guest think through their business problems. How do you support entrepreneurial spirit in your child? Thats what Marc explores in this weeks episode with the help of the first ever quartet of co-founders to appear on the show. Elementary schoolers Julianne, Zachary, Maxfield and Mark have created beverage brand Astronade and caught Marcs attention with their plucky marketing plan that even wound in their local mayor.

programme.title: Super Coffee: How to Scale Culture in a Family Business
programme.desc: Jordan DeCicco created Super Coffee in his dorm room when he was only 19 years old. He dropped out of college to go full-time on his side-hustle and now, together with his two brothers runs the bottled beverage brand out of Austin, Texas. With an impressive $125m in annual revenue, the DeCiccos have attracted big name investors including J. Lo and Alex Rodriguez. Their next step is tackling how to scale - not just domestically but also internationally.

programme.title: Dinner and Apps
programme.desc: Gary and the crew head to Seattle, Washington to talk with chef Edouardo Jordan, creator of Salare, a farm to table restaurant with rave reviews. Then they head to Ann Arbor, Michigan to talk to Skye Durrant and Brandon Bertrang founders of LawnGuru, an online lawn service and mobile app.

programme.title: How To Find A Job You Love and The Importance Of Having A Vision In Life
programme.desc: Having a vision matters because it will help you find a job you love. The thing is, too many people end up working jobs that make them feel unfulfilled. By taking time to figure out what you really want, you can set yourself on the path to finding your dream job. There are two broad categories of jobs out there: survival jobs and dream jobs. Survival jobs are those jobs that you take for a variety of reasons, but they arent really what you aspire to. Maybe you needed money to pay off a loan, or maybe a job didnt turn out the way you thought it would but you didnt feel like changing. Dream jobs, on the other hand, are jobs that make you feel alive. So why arent more of us working our dream jobs? Well, it can be difficult to find a job you love if you dont even know what that dream job would look like. This is why having a vision is so critical. A vision provides clarity and direction for your life.

programme.title: DON'T Compare Yourself To Others and Why Comparison Is Killing Your Joy
programme.desc: In the age of social media, comparison is an all too common issue. Whether we realize it or not, we're constantly comparing ourselves to others; the problem is that it's killing our joy. That's right. Much of the time, all it's doing is making us less satisfied with ourselves. We only see the best parts of people around us and compare them to the worst parts of our lives. Learn why we must stop this cycle, and exactly how you can do it.

programme.title: The Art of Being a Self Made Millionaire with Hip Hop's Hottest Rapper Nipsey Hussle
programme.desc: Nipsey Hussle is arguably hip hop's hottest star right now, with his much anticipated album release of Victory Lap. Hussle has been making his name from a steady stream of mixtapes including 2013s Crenshaw, which he sold at $100 a pop, netting $100,000 in the process. He's collaborated with artists like YG, Diddy, and Jeezy. His record label All In Records recently partnered with Atlantic Records to increase his distribution and he's turning the industry on its head by owning the rights to his music. He's an entrepreneur in every sense with multiple businesses including his record label, his clothing brand called The Marathon Company and is even an early investor in some blockchain based startups.

programme.title: The Greatest Company Inception Story with theChive Brothers
programme.desc: Brothers John Resig and Leo Resig founded Chive Media Group and its flagship site, theCHIVE.com, in November 2008 with no capital and a lot of hustle. Leo was living in Chicago (CHI) and John was living in Venice (VE) and thats how theCHIVE was born. With backgrounds in digital publishing and the financial backing from partner, Doug Schaaf, John and Leo were able to turn a three-man project into the nationwide, 170-employee entertainment digital media company that Chive Media Group is today.

programme.title: Learn How To Handle Anxiety & Face Your Fear Of The Future
programme.desc: Learning how to handle anxiety about the future is an essential step toward achieving your goals. When faced with uncertainty, we tend to fear the future. But it doesnt have to be this way. In this episode, we introduce a few strategies to stop letting fear get in your way. Learn effective methods for how to handle anxiety by interrupting your thoughts, turning your attention toward those thoughts, and questioning whether your fear of the future is genuinely valid.

programme.title: The Freelance Skills & Mindset You NEED To Succeed, or Freelancing For Beginners
programme.desc: With more and more of the workforce becoming freelance, we've got lots of people getting into this fantastic way of living, but we need to learn how to get started. Freelancing takes a set of skills and a mindset that many beginners don't quite understand fully, so it's essential to show you all the ropes so you can get started and take your business to the next level.

programme.desc: Rich Antoniello is the co-founder and CEO of Complex Media. Complex is the intersection between all things pop culture from hip hop to sneakers and dominates the male market of 18-24 with 55m monthly viewers. Through the companies latest annual conference, ComplexCon, they're now disrupting traditional retail by providing a fully immersive experience for event goers. They've been disrupting media for decades and caught the attention of Verizon and Hearst in 2016, who jointly acquired 50% of the company for reportedly well over $250m.

programme.title: A New Spin On Music & Business
programme.desc: MICK used music to propel his career. He has spun private events for some of the worlds most prominent celebrities, brands, tech companies and philanthropic organizations including Beyonce, Bravo, Cadillac, Entertainment Weekly, Fast Company, Gary Vaynerchuk, Hillary Clinton, HBO, Instagram, Interview Magazine, Jay Z, Jimmy Kimmel, LeBron James, Michelle Obama, and the list goes on. Through his influence he has become the center of everything relevant, tech and culture, and has used his brand to create massive opportunity.

programme.desc: In this episode, the Drapers and guest judges Love Yadav (General Partner at Mountain Lion Ventures) and Yureni Noshika (Actor, Model & TV Personality) assess four Sri Lankan startups: Nootz Coconut for tropical smoothies, SpectrifyAI for AI/ML tea and spice analysis, Hyperglade for Web2 to Web3 transition, and RHODA for sustainable urban mobility. Find out which startup moves to the semi-finals!

programme.title: Did Marc Just Get Career Envy?
programme.desc: James is an adventurer in both life and business. But when your career is breaking world records how do you turn that into a sustainable business? He thinks he found his answer when he created his wilderness team building program My Adventure Group and hes getting rave reviews. The trouble is, hes just not getting enough customers.

programme.title: Why Most Founders Can't Grow Past 25 Employees
programme.desc: Weebly co-founder David Rusenko reflects on scaling the company, confronting his own leadership challenges and the dinner with Richard Branson that changed his approach.

programme.title: Cheesy Effects
programme.desc: Gary and the crew head to Bandon, Oregon to talk with Greg Drobot and Daniel Graham, the co-founders of Facerock Creamery, an artisan cheese factory and retail store. Then they head to Poway, California to talk with Brea Joseph, the owner of KBZ FX, a special FX make-up studio.

programme.title: What Is Mindfulness? Start Living In The Present Moment And Do More With A Mindful Hustle
programme.desc: Being mindful and living in the present moment will allow you to keep up with the daily hustle without becoming too overwhelmed. Mindful hustle is the idea that you can be productive while pausing your mind throughout the day to stay present. By cultivating mindfulness throughout your day, you can avoid much of the stress that builds over the day.

programme.title: Setting Your Goals - Here's How To Achieve The Goals You Set
programme.desc: So many of us set big (or small) goals in life, but the reality is that so few of us hit those goals we set. If you want to achieve and surpass those goals, you need a reliable process to get you there. In this video, I will teach you exactly how to set goals in a way that pushes you toward them.

programme.title: Kym Gold Explains How She Started and Sold True Religion for $835M
programme.desc: Kym Gold is the co-creator of True Religion Brand Jeans; author of the business book Gold Standard: How to Rock the World and Run an Empire; and producer for projects with a social conscience, including the documentary SLAG: Served Like a Girl. Kyms unwavering drive has helped her achieve success as a designer and entrepreneur. She shares tips about life, business and selling her company for $800m+.

programme.title: Redefining Modern Art In The Graffiti Generation
programme.desc: Timmy Sneaks is a modern creative and graffiti artist from Boston. His unique style and brand has garnered interest from the highest level brand and influencers like Kevin Hart, Scott Disick and Robinson Cano. In this episode of Action & Ambition with Andrew Medal, Timmy discusses his beginnings and how he turned his passion for art into a thriving business, keys to luxury branding, and the vision for his empire.

programme.title: Drone Deliveries, Remote TV Scanners, & Age Monitoring
programme.desc: Meet Flytrex & their intelligent drone delivery system for any business. Order your drone package, and be delivered by drone in no time. JC visits WeWork Tel Aviv to find an exciting start-up that creates a TV scanner app to hear any audio on your phone from a TV in an airport, or train station. We also talk to Ruth about her impactful venture to help to monitor and protect us from old age.

programme.title: Futuristic Zappers, Robot Washers, & Brain Gaming
programme.desc: The Season Finale discovers five innovators who are making headway and, ranging from futuristic scanners that can detect the quality & makeup of fruit, meat, pills & other substances, to Autonomous Robot Window Washers that can scale tall buildings & Mind Controlled Games to assist with ADHD. Israel is a hotbed for innovation & houses more start-ups per capita than anywhere else.

programme.title: People Suck at Judging Other People
programme.desc: This episode is all about technology. From custom handbags to on-demand personal trainers, four creative entrepreneurs enter the elevator with high-tech ideas for everyday goods and services.

programme.title: Can a Saliva Test Tell You Whether He's the One?
programme.desc: Entrepreneurs pitch their solutions to various problems, from finding love to staying hydrated in bed. Plus, an all-in-one picture-hanging tool tries to level up the boardroom.

(carbon-free smart aerial mobility), E-panipurii kartz (touchless operation for Panipuri vendors), and Wow Mom (healthy fast food). The suspense builds as the judges decide who advances to the semi-finals and who goes home.

programme.title: Paris
programme.desc: In this episode, Tim Draper and guest judges Michael Amar, Samantha Bohbot, and Lars Seier Christensen assess innovative startups like Bubblemaps (blockchain data), Staex (Web3 connectivity for machines), Sneakmart (streetwear community app), Secret Keylabs (advanced Bitcoin wallet), and Playmakers (user-generated content platform for games). Tension builds as judges unveil which Paris startup advances to the semi-finals!

programme.title: From Psychedelics to a $28m+ Business Empire to New York Times Best Seller
programme.desc: Aubrey Marcus is the founder and CEO of Onnit, a lifestyle brand based on a holistic health philosophy he calls Total Human Optimization. Since its founding, Onnit has become an Inc. 500 company and industry leader with over 250 products ranging from peak performance supplements to foods, fitness equipment, and apparel. Inspired by his lifelong experience as a multisport athlete as well as his background in ancient philosophy his goal was to create a company that empowered customers to achieve their fullest human potential. With the launch of the firms flagship supplement Alpha BRAIN in 2011, Onnit was born.

programme.title: From State Pen to Y Combinator Graduate to Mega-Million Dollar Business
programme.desc: Frederick is the CEO and founder of Pigeonly, a low-cost communication and financial services platform that makes it easy for people to support an incarcerated loved one. He came up with the idea after serving time in the Federal Penitentiary for distributing 3,000 kg of weed. Hutson leads a growing team of over 20 people from their Las Vegas headquarters and has raised over $5MM in funding from investors.

programme.title: How To Sustain High Performance - Sami Inkinen of Virta Health
programme.desc: Sami Inkinen shares how a health scare changed his approach to entrepreneurship and led him to build Virta Health around the idea of sustainable high performance.

programme.desc: Gary and the crew head to White City, Oregon to talk with Richard and Renata Gyuro, the founder of Alpaca's at Lone Ranch, an Alpaca farm and retail store. Then they head over to Garden Grove, California to meet up with Diosdado Velasquez, the founder of Natures Kindle, handcrafted soy candles.

programme.title: Digital Music, Robots, Cyber Crime, & Art
programme.desc: Jonny Caplan shows why Israel is often referred to as The Silicon Valley of the Middle East or The Start-up Nation and why it's one of the leading places to build a start-up. Dont miss the AI robots at Tel Aviv University, and other exciting tech.

programme.title: Work Dating, Coded Lego, & Robot Companions
programme.desc: Our journey continues to find the best innovators and emerging entrepreneurs worldwide. Jonny & Jessy travel across Israel to find out what it took Danny from Algobrix to make supercharged coded Lego games, and Ron and the team, to create their revolutionary employment matching app. We also meet ElliQ, the AI Robot companion designed to engage and guard the elderly.

programme.desc: Prepare yourself for an electrifying episode as Tim Draper, accompanied by the dynamic duo Andrew Tang, Partner at Draper Associates, and Tyrone Lee, Venture Partner of Draper Associates, dive into riveting pitches from four Taiwanese trailblazers who are shaking up traditional norms with their cutting-edge solutions. Get ready for LuminX's revolutionary Cellular Tracking, Streamteck's cutting-edge medical AIoT service, Blocktag's seamless bridge between physical and digital worlds, and Bened Biomed's groundbreaking pharmaceutical marvels with novel probiotics for the nervous system. Feel the tension mount as the judges face the challenging task of selecting the crme de la crme for the highly-coveted semi-final round. The stakes are high, and the excitement is palpable as these groundbreaking companies battle it out for the ultimate spot in the limelight.

programme.title: Super Coffee: How to Scale Culture in a Family Business
programme.desc: Jordan DeCicco created Super Coffee in his dorm room when he was only 19 years old. With an impressive $125m in annual revenue, the DeCiccos have attracted big name investors including J. Lo and Alex Rodriguez. Their next step is tackling how to scale - not just domestically but also internationally.

Can this West Point grad prove both to Marc - and to the market - that his mix of reducing the juice and onboarding influencers is enough to get his platform off the ground?

programme.desc: Ron Boss Everline has made personal fitness and training his lifes work. Boss training programs have grown into the brand, Total Player LLC, an umbrella company he created to introduce luxury health and fitness.

He is also a seasoned investor and partner at Queenbridge Venture Partners and partner in popular Las Vegas shoe store, 12 AM RUN. programme.desc: Nipsey Hussle is arguably hip hop's hottest star right now, with his much anticipated album release of Victory Lap. Hussle has been making his name from a steady stream of mixtapes including 2013s Crenshaw, which he sold at $100 a pop, netting $100,000 in the process. He's collaborated with artists like YG, Diddy, and Jeezy. His record label All In Records recently partnered with Atlantic Records to increase his distribution and he's turning the industry on its head by owning the rights to his music. He's an entrepreneur in every sense with multiple businesses including his record label, his clothing brand called The Marathon Company and is even an early investor in some blockchain based startups.

programme.title: The Greatest Company Inception Story with theChive Brothers
programme.desc: Brothers John Resig and Leo Resig founded Chive Media Group and its flagship site, theCHIVE.com, in November 2008 with no capital and a lot of hustle. Leo was living in Chicago (CHI) and John was living in Venice (VE) and thats how theCHIVE was born. With backgrounds in digital publishing and the financial backing from partner, Doug Schaaf, John and Leo were able to turn a three-man project into the nationwide, 170-employee entertainment digital media company that Chive Media Group is today.

programme.desc: Meet Dr. Rafi Yoeli, who spent the last 30 years designing Flying Cars, Taxis & Rescue Vehicles. Also, see Holographic food menus, ordering, and drones that fly into burning buildings to warn the Fire Fighters before they venture in and risk their lives.

programme.title: Attack of the Drones, Planes, & Car Hackings
programme.desc: Drones have become increasingly popular but pose a significant security threat. Meet the inventors of intelligent 360-degree drone defense systems worth millions of dollars. We also visit an aeronautics technology fund, enhancing our air travel, and watch Jonnys connected car get hacked and taken over by a trained cybersecurity expert!

programme.title: Semifinals 2
programme.desc: Step into the heart of innovation at Hero City Silicon Valley as 'Meet the Drapers' brings you the intense semifinals! Join the renowned Draper family Bill, Tim, Polly, and Adam as they assess 13 dynamic startups competing fiercely for just three coveted spots in the upcoming finals. With anticipation running high, witness the thrilling journey of these startups as they vie for recognition and a chance to make it to the grand finale.

programme.title: Can you Create a Repeatable, Scalable Business When Your Business is You?
programme.desc: How many times have you been told that will never work? Probably not as often as Netflix co-founder Marc Randolph. Be a fly on the boardroom wall as Marc's podcast opens up the opportunity for entrepreneurs everywhere to gain the benefit of his years of experience as he helps each guest think through their business problems. Shes worked with celebrities, brands and magazines. But fashion photographer Sophie Elgort has hit a career juncture faced by many would-be entrepreneurs,

programme.title: Could This Business Rival Kumon?
programme.desc: Its no secret that the pandemic hammered small businesses - especially those with brick and mortar locations. But this weeks guest, Angela, wasnt going to let her thriving math enrichment business close, even when her store had to. As a prime example of the power of the pivot, shes actually managed to more than double her customer base and take her Philadelphia local business Trapezium Math, national by moving it online...

programme.title: Hub Repair
programme.desc: Gary and the crew head to Portland, Oregon to talk with Farhad Ghafarzade, the founder of Green Drop Garage, a, eco-friendly auto repair shop. Then they head over to San Diego, California to meet up with Felena Hanson, the founder of HeraHub, a female only co-working space.

programme.title: Level Up On IG Reels W/ Afnan Idris
programme.desc: If you understand your audience, you can monetize your IG Reels. Afnan Idris talks about Instagram Reels and how to grab attention and monetize them. Many influencers are gaining high viewership rates through IG Reels, and its critical that you understand your audience. People are waiting to hear your story, so grab attention and be relatable.

programme.title: What It Takes To Build A Successful Podcast w/ Shawn Anthony
programme.desc: Today Mario discusses all things podcasting with Shawn Anthony, the creator of School's Over...Now What? and Podcast Secrets Revealed. It takes a lot of hard work and patience to build and monetize your podcast. Yes, you want to monetize quickly but take some time to build authenticity and uniqueness. Ultimately, that will be your superpower.

programme.title: Here’s How to Sell Your Business For $100m+
programme.desc: Wayne Changs latest business, Crashlytics, sold to Twitter for over $100m+. Hes been involved with other notable startups like Dropbox, JetSmarter, Napster, DraftKings, and 50+ more now valued at over $30b. In this episode of Action & Ambition with Andrew Medal, he discusses his approach to startups, angel investing and life.

programme.title: How to Build The Hottest Celebrity Spot On the Planet
programme.desc: Mark Birnbaum is the co-founder of the EMM Group, who owns the Catch restaurant chain, which is arguably the hottest restaurants in the world with A-list celebrities visiting weekly. He recently sold 50% of his company to Tillman Fertitta the Texas billionaire who's the man behind the CNBC show Billion Dollar Buyer and also recently bought the 17 restaurants of BR Guest. In this episode of Action & Ambition with Andrew Medal, Mark discusses his beginnings and how he turned his passion for nightlife into a thriving business.

programme.title: Flying Cars, Holographic Food, & Autonomous Firefighters
programme.desc: Meet Dr. Rafi Yoeli, who spent the last 30 years designing Flying Cars, Taxis & Rescue Vehicles. Also, see Holographic food menus, ordering, and drones that fly into burning buildings to warn the Fire Fighters before they venture in and risk their lives.

programme.title: Attack of the Drones, Planes, & Car Hackings
programme.desc: Drones have become increasingly popular but pose a significant security threat. Meet the inventors of intelligent 360-degree drone defense systems worth millions of dollars. We also visit an aeronautics technology fund, enhancing our air travel, and watch Jonnys connected car get hacked and taken over by a trained cybersecurity expert!

programme.title: Simplifying Your Daily Routine
programme.desc: This week, entrepreneurs present ideas for improving mundane aspects of our everyday lives, from workwear to airline travel. Their products have the potential to make the daily grind a lot easier, freeing up more time for the hustle.

programme.title: I Don't Think We're the Right Investors
programme.desc: This weeks episode brings in high-flying valuations, with hopeful founders asking for millions from behind the closed Entrepreneur Elevator doors.

programme.title: Finale
programme.desc: Step into the electrifying atmosphere of Hero City for the grand finale of 'Meet the Drapers'! Seven dynamic startups stand on the brink of destiny, each vying for the prestigious 1 million dollar prize. As anticipation crackles in the air, the stage is set for an epic showdown of innovation, resilience, and entrepreneurial spirit.

programme.title: Denmark
programme.desc: Welcome to 'Meet the Drapers' global adventure! Venture capitalist Tim Draper leads a quest to discover billion-dollar startups worldwide. In Denmark, he teams up with Tine Thygesen and Torsten Kolind to evaluate standout startups such as Develop Diverse, Airflight, Cogo App, and Focalx.ai. Which Danish startup secures a spot in the semi-finals, and who captures the audience's hearts to stay in the competition? Join the journey of innovation and investment!

programme.title: Complex Used Hip Hop & Sneakers to Create 55M+ Viewers and Sell for Over $250M
programme.desc: Rich Antoniello is the co-founder and CEO of Complex Media. Complex is the intersection between all things pop culture from hip hop to sneakers and dominates the male market of 18-24 with 55m monthly viewers. Through the companies latest annual conference, ComplexCon, they're now disrupting traditional retail by providing a fully immersive experience for event goers. They've been disrupting media for decades and caught the attention of Verizon and Hearst in 2016, who jointly acquired 50% of the company for reportedly well over $250m.

programme.title: A New Spin On Music & Business
programme.desc: MICK used music to propel his career. He has spun private events for some of the worlds most prominent celebrities, brands, tech companies and philanthropic organizations including Beyonce, Bravo, Cadillac, Entertainment Weekly, Fast Company, Gary Vaynerchuk, Hillary Clinton, HBO, Instagram, Interview Magazine, Jay Z, Jimmy Kimmel, LeBron James, Michelle Obama, and the list goes on. Through his influence he has become the center of everything relevant, tech and culture, and has used his brand to create massive opportunity.

programme.title: How To Know If Your Business Idea Is A Winner
programme.desc: On this weeks full episode of Entrepreneur Elevator Pitch, investors hear their final round of pitches from entrepreneurs. When big money meets big ideas, everyone benefits. This weeks investors are Marc Randolph, co-founder and first CEO of Netflix; Kim Perell, CEO of 100.co and serial entrepreneur; and Rogers Healy, owner and CEO of Morrison Seger Venture Capital Partners.

programme.title: The Cheese Board
programme.desc: Gary and the crew head to San Francisco, California to talk with Taylor and Kevin, the founders of Blue Board, a unique employee reward company. Then they head to Portland, Oregon to meet up with Junea and Cameron Rocha, the creators of BraziBites, a company that specializes in Brazilian cheese bread.

programme.title: Creative Minds, Autonomous Cruising, & 3D Surgery
programme.desc: Jessy & Jonny visit the campus of IDC Herzliya, one of Israels leading universities, and test out some cool new experimental research projects. We also take you to meet Cortex, one of the leaders behind autonomous self-driving car technology, and discover the innovators of the mind-blowing 3D Holoscope holographic surgical assistance machine.

programme.title: AR Snowboarding, Surfing Freedom, & Robotic Soccer
programme.desc: RideOn conceptualized their Augmented Reality Snowboarding product while flying as fighter pilots in the army, and using similar technology. Meet CEO and Founder Alon Getz, and discover how some governments block internet access, and the makers of tools to help them access digital freedom.

programme.title: India
programme.desc: This week, the Drapers explore India with guests Nikhil Kamath and Nupur Hemant. Pitches include NextGeneration's orthopedic tech, Unstop's career platform, NeuroPixel's AI in fashion, and Karya's mobile solutions for rural India. Which startup will reach the semi-finals? Tune in!

programme.title: Did Marc Just Get Career Envy?
programme.desc: James is an adventurer in both life and business. But when your career is breaking world records how do you turn that into a sustainable business? He thinks he found his answer when he created his wilderness team building program My Adventure Group and hes getting rave reviews. The trouble is, hes just not getting enough customers.

programme.title: 130 Days Alone at Sea; Cole Brauer's Wild Story
programme.desc: Cole Brauer shares her journey sailing solo around the world, discussing resilience, overcoming challenges and setting a new speed record at sea.

programme.title: How Columbia Sportswear Stands Out in a Crowded Market
programme.desc: Columbia Sportswear CEO Tim Boyle discusses how the company repositioned its legacy brand by bringing more fun into the outdoor apparel industry.

programme.title: Edible Selfies, Extreme Beer Pong and More!
programme.desc: On our fast-paced pitch show, entrepreneurs seek investment from judges. The panel gets pitched a wide variety of items -- everything from fitness gear to edible selfies to an organic toilet bowl cleaner.

programme.title: More Secure Connections
programme.desc: On this week's episode of Entrepreneur Elevator Pitch, contestants present new ways to buy, sell and connect online -- and get around in the real world.

programme.title: Too Many Cooks in the Kitchen
programme.desc: This weeks batch of entrepreneurs will pitch updates to a variety of household products, many involving food; from pasta sauces to vitamins.

programme.title: The CEOs of Orzinga, & Grubhub
programme.desc: Introducing Ozinga, a 5th-generation family-owned American company supplying bulk materials and concrete solutions. Also, meet Adam DeWitt, outgoing Grubhub CEO, with finance expertise and board roles at Ritchie Bros. and The Joffrey Ballet.

programme.title: The CEOs of Hallow, & Decasonic
programme.desc: Introducing Alex Jones, CEO of Hallow, the #1 Christian prayer app, offering audio-guided meditation for spiritual growth. Also, meet Paul Hsu, CEO of Decasonic, a venture and digital assets fund, with experience at Zynga and as a founding member of NeoCarta.

programme.title: Creative Minds, Autonomous Cruising, & 3D Surgery
programme.desc: Jessy & Jonny visit the campus of IDC Herzliya, one of Israels leading universities, and test out some cool new experimental research projects. We also take you to meet Cortex, one of the leaders behind autonomous self-driving car technology, and discover the innovators of the mind-blowing 3D Holoscope holographic surgical assistance machine.

programme.desc: RideOn conceptualized their Augmented Reality Snowboarding product while flying as fighter pilots in the army, and using similar technology. Meet CEO and Founder Alon Getz, and discover how some governments block internet access, and the makers of tools to help them access digital freedom.

programme.desc: 10 años después de los últimos asesinatos atroces en la colina, Jack y Jill están de regreso para masacrar al elenco y al equipo de un programa de Internet en vivo que busca descubrir los secretos de la leyenda...

programme.title: El Demonio Interior
programme.desc: Años después de salir de la cárcel, Sam Parsons intenta rehacer su vida con su mujer Courtney y su hija Harper. Trabaja duro para mantener a su familia y permitirse una bonita casa en su tranquilo barrio de las afueras. Cuando empiezan a ocurrir sucesos sobrenaturales en la casa, Sam teme por la seguridad de su mujer y su hija. Cuando los sucesos se convierten en ataques, Sam contrata a Corbin Carlysle y a su equipo de cazafantasmas conocido como «The Ghost Killers», para que le ayuden a luchar contra la entidad oscura que acecha en las sombras de su casa. Cuando las cosas empiezan a complicarse y queda claro que esta entidad es mucho más peligrosa que el típico fantasma, surgen complicaciones cuando Corbin y su equipo se centran más en la fama y la fortuna. Para ganar esta lucha Sam debe luchar contra sus propios demonios interiores y volver a su violento pasado. Para salvar a sus seres queridos, un Demonio debe enfrentarse a un Demonio.

programme.title: Portal de Monstruos de H.P. Lovecraft
programme.desc: Una secta está a punto de despertar a la criatura más temida de H.P. Lovecraft...

programme.title: Jack y Jill
programme.desc: Una adaptación terrorífica de la canción infantil Jack y Jill. Un grupo de amigos afligidos por una pérdida reciente se reúnen sólo para descubrir que están siendo perseguidos por Jack y Jill...

programme.title: Krampus 2: El Diablo Regresa
programme.desc: Cinco años después del asesinato de su esposa y la desaparición de su hija, el ex policía Jeremy Duffin es traído de vuelta para ayudar en la caza de un monstruo de Yuletide que castiga a los niños que han sido «traviesos». A medida que el monstruo se vuelve más errático e impredecible, Jeremy descubre la verdad sobre la desaparición de su hija y el destino que le ha deparado una fuente improbable. ¿Podrá Jeremy acabar finalmente con la pesadilla del monstruo navideño que ha aterrorizado a este pueblo durante años?

programme.title: Contención
programme.desc: ¿Qué ocurre cuando estalla una epidemia y no se sabe nada? Puede ocurrir cualquier cosa. Poco a poco, los residentes se dan cuenta de que todos morirán a menos que se unan...

programme.title: Poltergeist Americano
programme.desc: Horribles visiones atormentan a Taryn cuando ella, su hermano y sus compañeros de universidad se mudan a una vieja e infame casa. Entonces, sus sangrientas alucinaciones se vuelven demasiado reales...

programme.title: Isla de las Muñecas
programme.desc: Un grupo de personas va a la legendaria Isla de las Muñecas para conocer la verdad mortal...

programme.title: El Mal Interior
programme.desc: Un chico solitario y mentalmente discapacitado se hace amigo de su reflejo en un espejo antiguo. Esta criatura demoníaca le ordena que se lance a una matanza asesina de las personas que más quiere...

programme.title: Ana
programme.desc: Dos hombres roban una muñeca de un museo que, sin saberlo, abre una puerta al Infierno...

programme.title: Alfredo
programme.desc: Brendan Cobbs, un famoso novelista, es enviado a una remota cabaña de la Inglaterra rural en busca de inspiración para su próxima novela. Cree haber encontrado su próximo tema cuando se encuentra con Alfred, un muñeco del tamaño de un niño que puede cobrar vida. Pero surgen consecuencias mortales cuando Brendan se da cuenta de que Alfred tiene intención de matar.

programme.title: Hotel Dinosaurio
programme.desc: Sienna está desesperada por ganar un gran premio en metálico en un concurso secreto clandestino, pero los dinosaurios comienzan a cazarla para entretenimiento de los ricos y adinerados. ¿Podrá ser la última en sobrevivir a la horrible noche para ganar el premio?

programme.title: Kecksburg
programme.desc: Un reportero investiga un misterioso accidente y descubre algo más que un objeto, sino una enorme conspiración gubernamental. Inspirada en los hechos reales del 9 de diciembre de 1965 y en uno de los incidentes OVNI más misteriosos de Estados Unidos...

programme.title: El Culto de Humpty Dumpty
programme.desc: Un grupo de adolescentes con problemas y su maestra deben luchar por sobrevivir después de descubrir que una secta ha devuelto la vida a Humpty Dumpty, un muñeco asesino, y lo ha liberado en el campamento en el que se encuentran...

programme.title: El Bosque del Diablo
programme.desc: Rachel y su equipo de cineastas viajan a Transilvania, Rumania, para documentar los fenómenos paranormales en el bosque de Hoia-Baciu...

programme.title: Mi Sangriento Cumpleaños
programme.desc: Tras un terrible trauma en su cumpleaños, Emma decide no volver a celebrarlo. Pero al cumplir 21, una amiga rompe el ritual con una fiesta sorpresa, sin percatarse del despertar de los horrores que durante años han estado acechando en la oscuridad...

programme.title: La Feria del Diablo
programme.desc: Protagonizada por Justin Duncan, Gerald Crum, Mercedes Peterson y John Charles Dickson. Las estrellas de dos series de televisión paranormales, rivales y enfrentadas, convergen en un parque de atracciones embrujado y abandonado que termina siendo el epicentro del infierno. Ahora están todos atrapados en una guerra sin cuartel contra el mal puro...

programme.title: Naufragio
programme.desc: Mientras transportaba un paquete importante, una joven sufre un accidente de coche en medio de la nada, dejándola atrapada debajo del coche. Poco a poco, se da cuenta de que no solo unos hombres muy malvados la persiguen para recuperar el objeto que transporta, sino que algo muy peligroso la acecha desde las profundidades del bosque...

programme.title: El Juego del Duende
programme.desc: Después de que un hombre adinerado envía a un grupo de ladrones a buscar leyendas urbanas con la intención de abrir un museo lleno de criaturas míticas, pronto descubrirán la leyenda de un duende...

programme.title: Verano Sangriento
programme.desc: Cuatro jóvenes llegan a Mallorca para disfrutar de unas idílicas vacaciones de verano, pero adentrándose en los lugares más inhóspitos de la isla comenzarán un viaje infernal...

programme.title: Juicios de Brujas
programme.desc: Dos realizadores de documentales y un ex policía investigan la desaparición de una niña que se rumorea que fue secuestrada por una bruja en los bosques encantados de Connecticut...

programme.title: Habitación Ouija
programme.desc: Una mujer agorafóbica con autismo comienza a invocar espíritus para que sean sus amigos mientras su hermano/cuidador está ausente durante el día, pero cuanto más tiempo pasa con los espíritus, más claro se vuelve que no son tan amigables después de todo...

programme.title: Serpiente
programme.desc: El equipo de construcción desarrolló a ciegas la isla desconocida, lo que alertó a las dos feroces criaturas de la isla para que fueran destruidas...

programme.title: Recuérdame
programme.desc: Rose despierta en una casa desconocida tras un grave accidente de coche, con pérdida de memoria y sin poder caminar. Su madre y su novio están allí para ayudarla. Rose quiere reconstruir su vida antes del accidente. No todo es lo que parece...

programme.title: La Maldición de la Sirena
programme.desc: Un joven se enamora de una joven seductora y sensual que conoce en la playa. Cuanto más se enamora de ella, más aprende los peligros de enamorarse de una sirena...

programme.title: Aldea del Vampiro
programme.desc: Rebecca busca a su hermana, una joven periodista desaparecida mientras investigaba una serie de desafortunados sucesos. El rastro la conduce a Timere, un lugar remoto alejado del ajetreo de la vida cotidiana, donde entre el hermético silencio de los habitantes del pueblo crece el temor a que actúen fuerzas oscuras y nadie se atreve a salir de casa por la noche. Aquí Rebecca conoce a un extravagante escritor, al guardián de la iglesia del pueblo y, sobre todo, a Caleb, un hombre encantador, rico y elegante cuya oscura mirada esconde un escalofriante secreto. Es en este pueblo, donde el tiempo parece moverse entre las sombras y el peligro acecha en cada esquina, donde Rebecca se entera de la terrible verdad y comienza la batalla entre el bien y el mal...

programme.title: Día del Abandono
programme.desc: Jenny Bilson, una estudiante de último curso de instituto, es la estudiante perfecta, la maravillosa hija de un veterano detective de policía y todo un sueño americano. Pero el único error que no es consciente de haber cometido está a punto de perseguirla de una forma muy violenta, cuando su pasado regresa en busca de venganza...

programme.title: Design Play
programme.desc: Play with color, contrast and shapes to create modern quilt designs. Color expert Rebecca Bryan pulls complementing and contrasting fabrics from her stash to inspire her designs. Fabric designer Luana Rubin and Heather Grant share ideas for charity quilts. Using templates and a lot of creative sass, Jen Carlton-Bailly cuts and sews all sorts of curves with stunning results.

programme.desc: Hit the slopes in style. Designer and fabric expert Linda Lee uses a specialty fabric normally used for envelopes and home insulation to make a warm, stylish ski vest. Then, put your feet up and relax. Sewing educator Rebecca Kemp Brent captures vacation memories in a charming tuffet, embellished with top-stitching.

programme.desc: Designer Wyatt White shows how to use a special bracelet jig to create fun and fashionable wire bangles and custom wire components. In her Beading Lesson, Katie braids knitted wire tubing and strings it together with stones and fibers to make a chunky multi-strand necklace.

programme.title: Episode 3: Stencils
programme.desc: This show offers lots of new tips and techniques using stencils. Create your own stencil and learn about masking with Jenny Barnett Rohrs. A short interview features Stacy Julian as she shares her system of "get it done fast". Then, Julie demonstrates a layering technique using new stencil designs. Last, Julie shares more stenciling tips using stamping, painting, doodling and more.

programme.desc: Get out your rose-colored glasses, or whatever props you need to take a fresh look at your art. Host Julie Fei Fan Balzer starts the show with a faux shibori dyeing demonstration. Every other week she has a lesson on a new way of looking at an aspect of art through your sketchbook. Today it's all about words. Explore interesting textures and shapes through writing and letters.

programme.title: Modern Ingenuity
programme.desc: This season is all about learning from the masters but we'd be remiss if we didn't also take time to feature some modern ingenuity. Katie takes a look at beads inspired by Monet as a nod to the past. Then Aja Vaz brings us into the current world with modern torches and making tube shaped beads. Then Katie is back with old meets new, as we look at new ways to set crystals. Finally Tammy shows us new and old loom types.

programme.title: Art Inspired Jewelry Making
programme.desc: Blogger Andrew Thornton talks about drawing inspiration from your art and turning your hobby into a business. Then, he shares one of his favorite new jewelry making techniques on making decorative end caps using epoxy clay. Katie's Beading Lesson is about using beaded chain for an easy necklace.

programme.title: Episode 13: Flowers
programme.desc: Flowers fill this episode. First Julie embellishes tags with a floral watercolor design to use on a page layout. Then Julie interviews May Flaum. Next, Kathy Cano-Murillo uses more flowers with her signature glitter style to add to her scrapbook page. Last, Julie cuts and pieces flower designs to use as card embellishments.

programme.title: Episode 1: Daily Activities
programme.desc: The first step in creating the make it artsy lifestyle is starting with daily activity. By reinforcing art daily, we develop a behavior and routine to being creative. Host Julie Fei Fan Balzer begins with a daily calendar, and then Jodi Ohl introduces us to her routine of coffee and watching the birds in her yard. Finally, artist Tori Weyers introduces us to a daily sketchbook practice. You can always find time for a simple artful expression.
